name: 46545 · Mishawaka, IN
findings: ZIP 46545 (Mishawaka) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46545 (Mishawaka) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46545 (Mishawaka) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
